    summary: "<h4>统一响应式基础设施</h4>\n<p><code>@kne/responsive-utils</code> 为 KNE 前端提供统一的断点 token、React Hooks、弹层边界与滚动上下文，避免各业务包各自手写 <code>768px</code> / <code>getPopupContainer</code>。</p>\n<h4>推荐接入顺序</h4>\n<ol>\n<li><strong>快速入门</strong>：按类名标记 boundary / scroll，包一层 <code>ResponsiveProvider</code>，用 <code>useIsMobile</code> + <code>usePopupContainer</code></li>\n<li><strong>ResponsiveProvider</strong>：理解 <code>viewport</code>（跟窗口）与 <code>container</code>（跟指定宽度）两种模式</li>\n<li><strong>目标类名</strong>：掌握 <code>RESPONSIVE_*_CLASS</code> —— 多数场景不必手传 ref</li>\n<li><strong>布局 Hooks</strong>：<code>useIsMobile</code> → <code>useBreakpoint</code> → <code>useMediaQuery</code></li>\n<li><strong>浮层与滚动</strong>：<code>usePopupContainer</code>、<code>useScrollElement</code></li>\n<li><strong>移动端弹层</strong>：<code>useMobilePopupMount</code>（业务只选 <code>cover</code>）</li>\n<li><strong>DOM 工具</strong>：无 React 树时的底层解析</li>\n</ol>\n<h4>主要能力</h4>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>能力</th>\n<th>入口</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td>移动端判定（&lt;768）</td>\n<td><code>useIsMobile</code> / <code>MOBILE_BREAKPOINT</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>多断点</td>\n<td><code>useBreakpoint</code> / <code>BREAKPOINTS</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>任意 media query</td>\n<td><code>useMediaQuery</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>弹层挂载边界</td>\n<td><code>usePopupContainer</code> + <code>RESPONSIVE_BOUNDARY_CLASS</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>滚动容器</td>\n<td><code>useScrollElement</code> + <code>RESPONSIVE_SCROLL_CLASS</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>移动端 Modal / 半屏</td>\n<td><code>useMobilePopupMount({ cover })</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>SCSS 容器查询</td>\n<td><code>@use '~@kne/responsive-utils/scss' as resp</code></td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h4>常见误区</h4>\n<ul>\n<li>不要手写 <code>@media (max-width: 768px)</code> 或自造断点常量；JS 用 Hooks，样式用包内 SCSS mixin</li>\n<li>跟浏览器窗口走用默认 <code>viewport</code>；按局部宽度模拟用 <code>mode=\"container\"</code> + <code>containerWidth</code></li>\n<li>移动端弹层只选 <code>cover: 'boundary' | 'viewport'</code>，不要自己拼挂载节点策略</li>\n</ul>",
    description: "Unified responsive breakpoints, hooks, popup boundary and scroll context for KNE projects.",

    api: "<h4>怎么选 API</h4>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>你想做的事</th>\n<th>用这个</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td>判断是不是移动端</td>\n<td><code>useIsMobile</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>按 xs~xxl 改布局</td>\n<td><code>useBreakpoint</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>任意 media query</td>\n<td><code>useMediaQuery</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>antd Select / DatePicker 不被裁剪</td>\n<td><code>usePopupContainer</code> + <code>RESPONSIVE_BOUNDARY_CLASS</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>拿到主内容滚动根</td>\n<td><code>useScrollElement</code> + <code>RESPONSIVE_SCROLL_CLASS</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>移动端 Modal / 半屏挂载</td>\n<td><code>useMobilePopupMount({ cover })</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>按局部容器宽度判定</td>\n<td><code>ResponsiveProvider mode=\"container\"</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>样式断点</td>\n<td>SCSS <code>@use '~@kne/responsive-utils/scss' as resp</code></td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<p>完整用法见各 Demo；下面是参数与返回值明细。</p>\n<h4>断点 Token</h4>\n<p>统一断点常量，与 SCSS mixin 同源。</p>\n<h5>导出</h5>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>名称</th>\n<th>类型</th>\n<th>默认值</th>\n<th>描述</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>BREAKPOINTS</code></td>\n<td><code>Record&lt;string, }</code></td>\n<td>断点像素值</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>MOBILE_BREAKPOINT</code></td>\n<td><code>number</code></td>\n<td><code>768</code></td>\n<td>移动端阈值，等于 <code>BREAKPOINTS.md</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>IS_MOBILE_QUERY</code></td>\n<td><code>string</code></td>\n<td><code>(max-width: 768px)</code></td>\n<td><code>matchMedia</code> 查询字符串</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>BREAKPOINT_KEYS</code></td>\n<td><code>string[]</code></td>\n<td><code>['xs','sm','md','lg','xl','xxl']</code></td>\n<td>断点 key 列表</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h4>SCSS</h4>\n<p>容器查询使用统一名称 <code>kne-responsive</code>（<code>$responsive-container-name</code>），业务方无需硬编码。</p>\n<p><strong>宿主元素</strong>（需要容器查询的根节点）：</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-scss\">@use '@kne/responsive-utils/scss' as resp;\n\n.page-host {\n  @include resp.responsive-container;\n}\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>子元素样式</strong>：</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-scss\">@include resp.mobile-container { ... }\n@include resp.container-down(md) { ... }\n@include resp.mobile { ... } // 视口 @media\n</code></pre>\n<h4>响应式目标类名</h4>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>名称</th>\n<th>类名</th>\n<th>用途</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>RESPONSIVE_CONTAINER_CLASS</code></td>\n<td><code>kne-responsive-container</code></td>\n<td>容器查询宿主（配合 <code>responsive-container</code> mixin）</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>RESPONSIVE_BOUNDARY_CLASS</code></td>\n<td><code>kne-responsive-boundary</code></td>\n<td>弹层挂载边界（<code>getPopupContainer</code> / <code>usePopupContainer</code>）</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>RESPONSIVE_SCROLL_CLASS</code></td>\n<td><code>kne-responsive-scroll</code></td>\n<td>滚动参照容器（<code>useScrollElement</code> / Affix / BackTop）</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<p>DOM 查找：<code>findResponsiveBoundary(anchor)</code>、<code>findResponsiveScroll(anchor)</code>。无自定义注入时 Provider 默认按类名解析，再回退 <code>body</code> / <code>documentElement</code>。</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-jsx\">&lt;div className={RESPONSIVE_CONTAINER_CLASS} /&gt;\n&lt;div className={RESPONSIVE_BOUNDARY_CLASS}&gt;{children}&lt;/div&gt;\n&lt;div className={RESPONSIVE_SCROLL_CLASS}&gt;{children}&lt;/div&gt;\n</code></pre>\n<h4>容器查询（JS / 内联样式）</h4>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>名称</th>\n<th>说明</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>containerMobileBlock(rules)</code></td>\n<td>生成移动端 <code>@container</code> 规则块，无需知道容器名</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>containerDownBlock('sm', rules)</code></td>\n<td>按断点 key 生成容器查询块</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>RESPONSIVE_CONTAINER_NAME</code></td>\n<td>高级场景用，一般不必直接使用</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<pre><code class=\"language-js\">import { containerMobileBlock } from '@kne/responsive-utils';\n\nconst css = `\n  .box { background: blue; }\n  ${containerMobileBlock('.box { background: green; }')}\n`;\n</code></pre>\n<h4>ResponsiveProvider</h4>\n<p>为子树注入响应式上下文，控制移动端判定、弹窗边界与滚动容器。</p>\n<h5>属性</h5>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>属性</th>\n<th>类型</th>\n<th>默认值</th>\n<th>描述</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>mode</code></td>\n<td><code>'viewport' | 'container'</code></td>\n<td><code>'viewport'</code></td>\n<td>视口模式或容器宽度模式</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>containerWidth</code></td>\n<td><code>number</code></td>\n<td>-</td>\n<td><code>container</code> 模式下用于 <code>useIsMobile</code> / <code>useBreakpoint</code> 的宽度</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>getBoundaryElement</code></td>\n<td><code>() =&gt; HTMLElement</code></td>\n<td>-</td>\n<td>自定义弹窗挂载边界</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>getScrollElement</code></td>\n<td><code>() =&gt; HTMLElement</code></td>\n<td>-</td>\n<td>自定义滚动参照元素</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>boundaryRef</code></td>\n<td><code>RefObject&lt;HTMLElement&gt;</code></td>\n<td>-</td>\n<td>边界 DOM ref，优先级低于 <code>getBoundaryElement</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>scrollRef</code></td>\n<td><code>RefObject&lt;HTMLElement&gt;</code></td>\n<td>-</td>\n<td>滚动容器 ref</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>scrollAnchorRef</code></td>\n<td><code>RefObject&lt;HTMLElement&gt;</code></td>\n<td>-</td>\n<td>从锚点向上解析滚动父级</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h4>useIsMobile</h4>\n<p>判断当前是否为移动端（宽度 &lt; 768px）。</p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>返回值</th>\n<th>类型</th>\n<th>描述</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>isMobile</code></td>\n<td><code>boolean</code></td>\n<td>视口或容器宽度是否小于 <code>md</code></td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<p>无 Provider 时回退到 <code>(max-width: 768px)</code> 的 <code>matchMedia</code>。</p>\n<h4>useBreakpoint</h4>\n<p>返回各断点命中状态与 <code>isMobile</code>。</p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>返回值</th>\n<th>类型</th>\n<th>描述</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>xs</code> ~ <code>xxl</code></td>\n<td><code>boolean</code></td>\n<td>当前宽度是否达到对应断点</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>isMobile</code></td>\n<td><code>boolean</code></td>\n<td>同 <code>useIsMobile</code></td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h4>useMediaQuery</h4>\n<p>订阅任意 CSS media query。</p>\n<h5>参数</h5>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>参数</th>\n<th>类型</th>\n<th>默认值</th>\n<th>描述</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>query</code></td>\n<td><code>string</code></td>\n<td>-</td>\n<td>标准 media query 字符串</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>返回值</th>\n<th>类型</th>\n<th>描述</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>matches</code></td>\n<td><code>boolean</code></td>\n<td>查询是否命中</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<p><code>container</code> 模式下对含 <code>max-width</code> 的 query 会映射到 <code>getIsMobile()</code>。</p>\n<h4>usePopupContainer</h4>\n<p>返回 antd <code>getPopupContainer</code> 回调。</p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>返回值</th>\n<th>类型</th>\n<th>描述</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>getPopupContainer</code></td>\n<td><code>() =&gt; HTMLElement</code></td>\n<td>弹窗挂载边界 getter</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h4>useScrollElement</h4>\n<p>返回滚动容器 getter。</p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>返回值</th>\n<th>类型</th>\n<th>描述</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>getScrollElement</code></td>\n<td><code>() =&gt; HTMLElement</code></td>\n<td>滚动参照元素 getter</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h4>移动端弹层挂载（推荐）</h4>\n<p>业务只关心「罩住哪」：选 <code>cover</code> 即可，挂载节点与定位类名由库根据 Provider 模式自动决定。</p>\n<h5>常量</h5>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>名称</th>\n<th>值</th>\n<th>描述</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>MOBILE_POPUP_MODE.boundary</code></td>\n<td><code>kne-is-boundary</code></td>\n<td>相对 boundary <code>absolute</code>（组件自行写 CSS）</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>MOBILE_POPUP_MODE.viewport</code></td>\n<td><code>kne-is-viewport</code></td>\n<td>相对视口 <code>fixed</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>MOBILE_POPUP_COVER.boundary</code></td>\n<td><code>boundary</code></td>\n<td>罩住 Provider boundary（<strong>默认</strong>，Modal）</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>MOBILE_POPUP_COVER.viewport</code></td>\n<td><code>viewport</code></td>\n<td>罩住当前移动可视区域（半屏 Select）</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h5><code>useMobilePopupMount</code></h5>\n<pre><code class=\"language-jsx\">import { useMobilePopupMount } from '@kne/responsive-utils';\n\n// Modal：默认挂 boundary\nconst { isMobile, getPopupContainer, fixedModeClass, anchorRef } = useMobilePopupMount();\n\n// 底部半屏\nconst sheet = useMobilePopupMount({ cover: 'viewport' });\n</code></pre>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>参数</th>\n<th>类型</th>\n<th>默认</th>\n<th>描述</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>cover</code></td>\n<td><code>'boundary' | 'viewport'</code></td>\n<td><code>'boundary'</code></td>\n<td>弹层罩住范围</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>getPopupContainer</code></td>\n<td><code>(trigger?) =&gt; HTMLElement | null</code></td>\n<td>-</td>\n<td>调用方覆盖挂载节点</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>返回值</th>\n<th>类型</th>\n<th>描述</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>isMobile</code></td>\n<td><code>boolean</code></td>\n<td>是否移动端 UI</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>fixedModeClass</code></td>\n<td><code>string | null</code></td>\n<td><code>kne-is-boundary</code> / <code>kne-is-viewport</code> / 桌面 <code>null</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>getMountNode</code></td>\n<td><code>(trigger?) =&gt; HTMLElement | null</code></td>\n<td>portal 挂载节点</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>getPopupContainer</code></td>\n<td><code>(trigger?) =&gt; HTMLElement</code></td>\n<td>可直接给 Antd</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>resolveMount</code></td>\n<td><code>(trigger?) =&gt; { isMobile, fixedModeClass, mountNode, ... }</code></td>\n<td>命令式打开时按触发点同步解析</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>anchorRef</code></td>\n<td><code>(node) =&gt; void</code></td>\n<td>挂到触发器上，便于解析挂载上下文</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<p>行为摘要：</p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th><code>cover</code></th>\n<th><code>mode=container</code>（或嵌套 boundary）</th>\n<th><code>mode=viewport</code> 且移动端</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>boundary</code></td>\n<td>boundary + <code>kne-is-boundary</code></td>\n<td>boundary + <code>kne-is-boundary</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>viewport</code></td>\n<td>boundary + <code>kne-is-boundary</code></td>\n<td><code>body</code> + <code>kne-is-viewport</code></td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<p>另有 <code>useMobileFixedMode</code>、<code>resolveMobilePopupContainer</code> 等供高级/测试场景。</p>\n<h4>DOM 工具</h4>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>函数</th>\n<th>参数</th>\n<th>返回值</th>\n<th>描述</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>findScrollParent</code></td>\n<td><code>(element: HTMLElement)</code></td>\n<td><code>HTMLElement | null</code></td>\n<td>向上查找最近可滚动祖先</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>findResponsiveBoundary</code></td>\n<td><code>(anchor?)</code></td>\n<td><code>HTMLElement | null</code></td>\n<td>查找     title: "快速入门",
    description: "推荐最小接入：目标类名 + ResponsiveProvider + useIsMobile + usePopupContainer",
    code: "/**\n * 快速入门：一条业务页最小接入模板\n *\n * 1. 用目标类名标记 boundary / scroll\n * 2. 最外层包 ResponsiveProvider（多数场景可省略，靠类名兜底）\n * 3. 布局用 useIsMobile，浮层用 usePopupContainer\n */\nconst {\n  ResponsiveProvider,\n  RESPONSIVE_BOUNDARY_CLASS,\n  RESPONSIVE_SCROLL_CLASS,\n  MOBILE_BREAKPOINT,\n  BREAKPOINTS,\n  useIsMobile,\n  usePopupContainer\n} = _ResponsiveUtils;\nconst {Alert, Card, DatePicker, Flex, Form, Select, Space, Tag, Typography} = antd;\n\nconst DEPARTMENT_OPTIONS = [\n  {label: '研发中心 / 前端组', value: 'fe'},\n  {label: '研发中心 / 后端组', value: 'be'},\n  {label: '产品中心 / 用户研究', value: 'research'},\n  {label: '运营中心 / 增长运营', value: 'growth'}\n];\n\n/** 业务组件：只关心「移动还是桌面」「浮层挂到哪」 */\nconst StaffFilterForm = () => {\n  const isMobile = useIsMobile();\n  const getPopupContainer = usePopupContainer();\n\n  return (\n    <Card\n      size=\"small\"\n      title={\n        <Space>\n          <span>员工筛选</span>\n          <Tag color={isMobile ? 'orange' : 'blue'}>{isMobile ? '移动布局' : '桌面布局'}</Tag>\n        </Space>\n      }\n    >\n      <Form layout={isMobile ? 'vertical' : 'inline'}>\n        <Form.Item label=\"所属部门\" name=\"dept\" style={isMobile ? undefined : {marginBottom: 0}}>\n          <Select\n            allowClear\n            placeholder=\"选择部门\"\n            options={DEPARTMENT_OPTIONS}\n            style={{width: isMobile ? '100%' : 220}}\n            getPopupContainer={getPopupContainer}\n          />\n        </Form.Item>\n        <Form.Item label=\"入职日期\" name=\"joinDate\" style={isMobile ? undefined : {marginBottom: 0}}>\n          <DatePicker\n            style={{width: isMobile ? '100%' : 180}}\n            getPopupContainer={getPopupContainer}\n            placeholder=\"选择日期\"\n          />\n        </Form.Item>\n      </Form>\n      <Typography.Paragraph type=\"secondary\" style={{marginTop: 12, marginBottom: 0}}>\n        缩小浏览器窗口（或使用下方「容器模式」相关 Demo），观察表单布局与下拉挂载是否跟随移动端切换。\n      </Typography.Paragraph>\n    </Card>\n  );\n};\n\nconst BaseExample = () => {\n  return (\n    <Flex vertical gap={16}>\n      <Alert\n        showIcon\n        type=\"info\"\n        message=\"本页是推荐最小接入模板\"\n        description={\n          <span>\n            阈值 <Typography.Text code>{MOBILE_BREAKPOINT}px</Typography.Text>（即{' '}\n            <Typography.Text code>BREAKPOINTS.md = {BREAKPOINTS.md}</Typography.Text>\n            ）。标记{' '}\n            <Typography.Text code>{RESPONSIVE_BOUNDARY_CLASS}</Typography.Text> /{' '}\n            <Typography.Text code>{RESPONSIVE_SCROLL_CLASS}</Typography.Text>\n            后，Hook 会自动解析边界与滚动根。\n          </span>\n        }\n      />\n\n      <pre\n        style={{\n          margin: 0,\n          padding: 12,\n          background: '#fafafa',\n          borderRadius: 6,\n          fontSize: 12,\n          lineHeight: 1.6,\n          whiteSpace: 'pre-wrap'\n        }}\n      >{`import {\n  ResponsiveProvider,\n  RESPONSIVE_BOUNDARY_CLASS,\n  RESPONSIVE_SCROLL_CLASS,\n  useIsMobile,\n  usePopupContainer\n} from '@kne/responsive-utils';\n\n<div className={RESPONSIVE_BOUNDARY_CLASS} style={{ position: 'relative' }}>\n  <div className={RESPONSIVE_SCROLL_CLASS} style={{ overflow: 'auto', height: '100%' }}>\n    <ResponsiveProvider>\n      <YourPage />\n    </ResponsiveProvider>\n  </div>\n</div>`}</pre>\n\n      <div\n        className={RESPONSIVE_BOUNDARY_CLASS}\n        style={{\n          position: 'relative',\n          border: '1px dashed #91caff',\n          borderRadius: 8,\n          overflow: 'hidden',\n          background: '#f0f5ff'\n        }}\n      >\n        <Typography.Text type=\"secondary\" style={{display: 'block', padding: '8px 12px 0'}}>\n          .{RESPONSIVE_BOUNDARY_CLASS}（弹层边界）\n        </Typography.Text>\n        <div\n          className={RESPONSIVE_SCROLL_CLASS}\n          style={{maxHeight: 360, overflow: 'auto', padding: 12}}\n        >\n          <ResponsiveProvider>\n            <StaffFilterForm />\n            <Card size=\"small\" style={{marginTop: 12}} title=\"列表占位\">\n              {['张三 · 前端工程师', '李四 · 产品经理', '王五 · 运营专员'].map(item => (\n                <div key={item} style={{padding: '8px 0', borderBottom: '1px solid #f0f0f0'}}>\n                  {item}\n                </div>\n              ))}\n            </Card>\n          </ResponsiveProvider>\n        </div>\n      </div>\n    </Flex>\n  );\n};\n\nrender(<BaseExample />);\n\n",

    title: "ResponsiveProvider",
    description: "viewport / container 模式、boundaryRef / scrollRef，以及与目标类名的配合",
    code: "/**\n * ResponsiveProvider：注入响应式上下文\n *\n * - viewport：跟浏览器窗口走（默认）\n * - container：跟 containerWidth 走（嵌入式布局 / 按指定宽度模拟）\n * - boundaryRef / scrollRef：显式指定挂载边界与滚动根（优先级高于类名查找）\n */\nconst {\n  ResponsiveProvider,\n  RESPONSIVE_BOUNDARY_CLASS,\n  RESPONSIVE_SCROLL_CLASS,\n  useIsMobile,\n  usePopupContainer,\n  useScrollElement,\n  useResponsiveContext\n} = _ResponsiveUtils;\nconst {Alert, Card, DatePicker, Flex, InputNumber, Select, Space, Switch, Tag, Typography} = antd;\nconst {useEffect, useRef, useState} = React;\n\nconst DEVICE_PRESETS = [\n  {label: 'iPhone SE · 375', value: 375},\n  {label: '临界 · 768', value: 768},\n  {label: 'iPad · 1024', value: 1024},\n  {label: '桌面 · 1440', value: 1440}\n];\n\nconst LivePanel = () => {\n  const isMobile = useIsMobile();\n  const {mode, containerWidth} = useResponsiveContext();\n  const getPopupContainer = usePopupContainer();\n  const getScrollElement = useScrollElement();\n  const [scrollTop, setScrollTop] = useState(0);\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    const el = getScrollElement();\n    if (!el) return undefined;\n    const onScroll = () => setScrollTop(Math.round(el.scrollTop || 0));\n    el.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll, {passive: true});\n    onScroll();\n    return () => el.removeEventListener('scroll', onScroll);\n  }, [getScrollElement]);\n\n  return (\n    <Flex vertical gap={12}>\n      <Space wrap>\n        <Tag>mode={mode}</Tag>\n        {mode === 'container' && <Tag color=\"purple\">containerWidth={containerWidth}px</Tag>}\n        <Tag color={isMobile ? 'orange' : 'blue'}>isMobile={String(isMobile)}</Tag>\n        <Tag>scrollTop={scrollTop}px</Tag>\n      </Space>\n      <Select\n        style={{width: '100%'}}\n        placeholder=\"选择汇报线部门\"\n        getPopupContainer={getPopupContainer}\n        options={[\n          {label: '华北区', value: 'north'},\n          {label: '华东区', value: 'east'},\n          {label: '华南区', value: 'south'}\n        ]}\n      />\n      <DatePicker style={{width: '100%'}} getPopupContainer={getPopupContainer} placeholder=\"生效日\" />\n      <Typography.Paragraph type=\"secondary\" style={{marginBottom: 0}}>\n        在下方滚动区滑动，观察 scrollTop；切换模式 / 宽度观察 isMobile 是否变化。\n      </Typography.Paragraph>\n      {Array.from({length: 6}, (_, i) => (\n        <Card key={i} size=\"small\" type=\"inner\">\n          审批记录 #{2024001 + i} · 差旅报销\n        </Card>\n      ))}\n    </Flex>\n  );\n};\n\nconst ResponsiveProviderExample = () => {\n  const [containerMode, setContainerMode] = useState(true);\n  const [containerWidth, setContainerWidth] = useState(375);\n  const boundaryRef = useRef(null);\n  const scrollRef = useRef(null);\n\n  return (\n    <Flex vertical gap={16}>\n      <Alert\n        showIcon\n        type=\"info\"\n        message=\"什么时候用哪种 mode？\"\n        description={\n          <ul style={{margin: 0, paddingLeft: 18}}>\n            <li>\n              <Typography.Text code>viewport</Typography.Text>：跟{' '}\n              <Typography.Text code>window</Typography.Text> 宽度走（默认）\n            </li>\n            <li>\n              <Typography.Text code>container</Typography.Text>：跟指定的{' '}\n              <Typography.Text code>containerWidth</Typography.Text> 走，适合嵌入式区域或本地模拟宽度\n            </li>\n          </ul>\n        }\n      />\n\n      <Card size=\"small\" title=\"控制台\">\n        <Flex gap={16} align=\"center\" wrap=\"wrap\">\n          <Space>\n            <Typography.Text>容器模式</Typography.Text>\n            <Switch checked={containerMode} onChange={setContainerMode} />\n          </Space>\n          {containerMode && (\n            <Space wrap>\n              <Typography.Text>模拟宽度</Typography.Text>\n              <InputNumber\n                min={320}\n                max={1600}\n                value={containerWidth}\n                onChange={v => setContainerWidth(v || 375)}\n                addonAfter=\"px\"\n              />\n              <Select\n                style={{width: 180}}\n                value={containerWidth}\n                onChange={setContainerWidth}\n                options={DEVICE_PRESETS}\n              />\n            </Space>\n          )}\n        </Flex>\n      </Card>\n\n      <div\n        ref={boundaryRef}\n        className={RESPONSIVE_BOUNDARY_CLASS}\n        style={{\n          position: 'relative',\n          border: '1px dashed #91caff',\n          borderRadius: 8,\n          padding: 12,\n          background: '#f0f5ff'\n        }}\n      >\n        <Typography.Text type=\"secondary\" style={{display: 'block', marginBottom: 8}}>\n          boundaryRef + .{RESPONSIVE_BOUNDARY_CLASS}（浮层挂到这里）\n        </Typography.Text>\n        <div\n          ref={scrollRef}\n          className={RESPONSIVE_SCROLL_CLASS}\n          style={{\n            height: 240,\n            overflow: 'auto',\n            border: '1px solid #d9d9d9',\n            borderRadius: 6,\n            padding: 12,\n            background: '#fff'\n          }}\n        >\n          <ResponsiveProvider\n            mode={containerMode ? 'container' : 'viewport'}\n            containerWidth={containerMode ? containerWidth : undefined}\n            boundaryRef={boundaryRef}\n            scrollRef={scrollRef}\n          >\n            <LivePanel />\n          </ResponsiveProvider>\n        </div>\n      </div>\n\n      <Typography.Paragraph type=\"secondary\" style={{marginBottom: 0}}>\n        也可只写类名、不传 ref：Provider 会通过{' '}\n        <Typography.Text code>findResponsiveBoundary</Typography.Text> /{' '}\n        <Typography.Text code>findResponsiveScroll</Typography.Text> 向上查找。见「目标类名」示例。\n      </Typography.Paragraph>\n    </Flex>\n  );\n};\n\nrender(<ResponsiveProviderExample />);\n\n",

    title: "目标类名",
    description: "RESPONSIVE_CONTAINER / BOUNDARY / SCROLL 三类约定，以及 findResponsive* 解析",
    code: "/**\n * 目标类名：推荐的页面结构约定\n *\n * 在布局根节点打上这三个类后，Provider / Hooks 可自动解析，无需层层传 ref。\n * Global、system-layout 等布局容器均按同一约定接线。\n */\nconst {\n  ResponsiveProvider,\n  RESPONSIVE_CONTAINER_CLASS,\n  RESPONSIVE_BOUNDARY_CLASS,\n  RESPONSIVE_SCROLL_CLASS,\n  findResponsiveBoundary,\n  findResponsiveScroll,\n  useIsMobile,\n  usePopupContainer\n} = _ResponsiveUtils;\nconst {Alert, Button, Card, Descriptions, Flex, Select, Space, Tag, Typography} = antd;\nconst {useRef, useState} = React;\n\nconst Probe = () => {\n  const isMobile = useIsMobile();\n  const getPopupContainer = usePopupContainer();\n  const anchorRef = useRef(null);\n  const [result, setResult] = useState(null);\n\n  const inspect = () => {\n    const anchor = anchorRef.current;\n    const boundary = findResponsiveBoundary(anchor);\n    const scroll = findResponsiveScroll(anchor);\n    const popup = getPopupContainer();\n    setResult({\n      isMobile,\n      boundary: boundary ? `.${boundary.className.split(' ').filter(Boolean).join('.')}` : 'null',\n      scroll: scroll ? `.${scroll.className.split(' ').filter(Boolean).join('.')}` : 'null',\n      popup: popup === document.body ? 'document.body' : popup?.className || popup?.tagName\n    });\n  };\n\n  return (\n    <Flex vertical gap={12}>\n      <Space wrap>\n        <Tag color={isMobile ? 'orange' : 'blue'}>useIsMobile → {String(isMobile)}</Tag>\n        <span ref={anchorRef} />\n        <Button type=\"primary\" onClick={inspect}>\n          从当前锚点解析 boundary / scroll\n        </Button>\n      </Space>\n      <Select\n        style={{width: '100%'}}\n        placeholder=\"下拉会挂到 boundary\"\n        getPopupContainer={getPopupContainer}\n        options={[\n          {label: '招聘需求', value: 'req'},\n          {label: '候选人', value: 'cand'},\n          {label: 'offer 审批', value: 'offer'}\n        ]}\n      />\n      {result && (\n        <Descriptions size=\"small\" column={1} bordered>\n          <Descriptions.Item label=\"findResponsiveBoundary\">{result.boundary}</Descriptions.Item>\n          <Descriptions.Item label=\"findResponsiveScroll\">{result.scroll}</Descriptions.Item>\n          <Descriptions.Item label=\"usePopupContainer()\">{result.popup}</Descriptions.Item>\n        </Descriptions>\n      )}\n    </Flex>\n  );\n};\n\nconst TargetClassesExample = () => {\n  return (\n    <Flex vertical gap={16}>\n      <Alert\n        showIcon\n        type=\"info\"\n        message=\"三个类名各管一件事\"\n        description={\n          <Descriptions size=\"small\" column={1} style={{marginTop: 8}}>\n            <Descriptions.Item label={RESPONSIVE_CONTAINER_CLASS}>\n              容器查询宿主（配合 SCSS <Typography.Text code>@include resp.responsive-container</Typography.Text>\n              ）\n            </Descriptions.Item>\n            <Descriptions.Item label={RESPONSIVE_BOUNDARY_CLASS}>\n              弹层挂载边界（Select / DatePicker / Modal）\n            </Descriptions.Item>\n            <Descriptions.Item label={RESPONSIVE_SCROLL_CLASS}>\n              滚动参照（Affix、BackTop、虚拟列表、锚点）\n            </Descriptions.Item>\n          </Descriptions>\n        }\n      />\n\n      <pre\n        style={{\n          margin: 0,\n          padding: 12,\n          background: '#fafafa',\n          borderRadius: 6,\n          fontSize: 12,\n          lineHeight: 1.6,\n          whiteSpace: 'pre-wrap'\n        }}\n      >{`<div className={RESPONSIVE_CONTAINER_CLASS}>\n  <div className={RESPONSIVE_BOUNDARY_CLASS} style={{ position: 'relative' }}>\n    <div className={RESPONSIVE_SCROLL_CLASS} style={{ overflow: 'auto', height: '100%' }}>\n      <ResponsiveProvider>{children}</ResponsiveProvider>\n    </div>\n  </div>\n</div>`}</pre>\n\n      <div\n        className={RESPONSIVE_CONTAINER_CLASS}\n        style={{border: '1px solid #b7eb8f', borderRadius: 8, padding: 8, background: '#f6ffed'}}\n      >\n        <Typography.Text type=\"secondary\" style={{display: 'block', marginBottom: 8}}>\n          .{RESPONSIVE_CONTAINER_CLASS}\n        </Typography.Text>\n        <div\n          className={RESPONSIVE_BOUNDARY_CLASS}\n          style={{\n            position: 'relative',\n            border: '1px dashed #91caff',\n            borderRadius: 8,\n            padding: 8,\n            background: '#f0f5ff'\n          }}\n        >\n          <Typography.Text type=\"secondary\" style={{display: 'block', marginBottom: 8}}>\n            .{RESPONSIVE_BOUNDARY_CLASS}\n          </Typography.Text>\n          <div\n            className={RESPONSIVE_SCROLL_CLASS}\n            style={{\n              height: 200,\n              overflow: 'auto',\n              border: '1px solid #d9d9d9',\n              borderRadius: 6,\n              padding: 12,\n              background: '#fff'\n            }}\n          >\n            <Typography.Text type=\"secondary\" style={{display: 'block', marginBottom: 8}}>\n              .{RESPONSIVE_SCROLL_CLASS}\n            </Typography.Text>\n            <ResponsiveProvider>\n              <Probe />\n              <div style={{height: 160}} />\n            </ResponsiveProvider>\n          </div>\n        </div>\n      </div>\n\n      <Card size=\"small\">\n        <Typography.Paragraph type=\"secondary\" style={{marginBottom: 0}}>\n          传 <Typography.Text code>boundaryRef</Typography.Text> /{' '}\n          <Typography.Text code>scrollRef</Typography.Text> 时以 ref 为准；没传则按类名从触发器向上找，再回退{' '}\n          <Typography.Text code>body</Typography.Text> / 文档滚动根。\n        </Typography.Paragraph>\n      </Card>\n    </Flex>\n  );\n};\n\nrender(<TargetClassesExample />);\n\n",

    title: "useIsMobile",
    description: "按 768px 切换布局：侧栏、订单列表卡片化、容器宽度模拟",
    code: "/**\n * useIsMobile：宽度 < 768 时为 true\n *\n * 典型用途：侧栏折叠、表格⇄卡片、底部操作栏、表单 vertical/inline\n * container 模式下看 containerWidth，不看浏览器视口\n */\nconst {ResponsiveProvider, MOBILE_BREAKPOINT, useIsMobile} = _ResponsiveUtils;\nconst {Alert, Card, Col, Flex, InputNumber, Radio, Row, Space, Tag, Typography} = antd;\nconst {useState} = React;\n\nconst ORDERS = [\n  {id: 'ORD-20240701-001', customer: '华东分公司', amount: '¥12,800', status: '待发货'},\n  {id: 'ORD-20240701-002', customer: '华南渠道部', amount: '¥6,420', status: '已发货'},\n  {id: 'ORD-20240701-003', customer: '华北直客', amount: '¥28,100', status: '待审核'}\n];\n\nconst OrderBoard = () => {\n  const isMobile = useIsMobile();\n\n  return (\n    <Card\n      size=\"small\"\n      title={\n        <Space>\n          <span>订单列表</span>\n          <Tag color={isMobile ? 'orange' : 'geekblue'}>\n            {isMobile ? '卡片列表' : '三列栅格'}\n          </Tag>\n        </Space>\n      }\n      extra={\n        isMobile ? (\n          <Typography.Link>筛选</Typography.Link>\n        ) : (\n          <Space>\n            <Typography.Link>导出</Typography.Link>\n            <Typography.Link>批量发货</Typography.Link>\n          </Space>\n        )\n      }\n    >\n      {isMobile ? (\n        <Flex vertical gap={8}>\n          {ORDERS.map(item => (\n            <Card key={item.id} size=\"small\" type=\"inner\">\n              <Flex justify=\"space-between\">\n                <Typography.Text strong>{item.id}</Typography.Text>\n                <Tag>{item.status}</Tag>\n              </Flex>\n              <Typography.Text type=\"secondary\">\n                {item.customer} · {item.amount}\n              </Typography.Text>\n            </Card>\n          ))}\n        </Flex>\n      ) : (\n        <Row gutter={[12, 12]}>\n          {ORDERS.map(item => (\n            <Col key={item.id} span={8}>\n              <Card size=\"small\">\n                <Typography.Text strong>{item.id}</Typography.Text>\n                <br />\n                <Typography.Text type=\"secondary\">\n                  {item.customer} · {item.amount}\n                </Typography.Text>\n                <br />\n                <Tag style={{marginTop: 8}}>{item.status}</Tag>\n              </Card>\n            </Col>\n          ))}\n        </Row>\n      )}\n    </Card>\n  );\n};\n\nconst Shell = ({children}) => {\n  const isMobile = useIsMobile();\n  return (\n    <div\n      style={{\n        display: 'flex',\n        minHeight: 280,\n        border: '1px solid #f0f0f0',\n        borderRadius: 8,\n        overflow: 'hidden'\n      }}\n    >\n      {!isMobile && (\n        <div style={{width: 160, padding: 12, background: '#001529', color: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.85)'}}>\n          <Typography.Text style={{color: '#fff'}} strong>\n            导航\n          </Typography.Text>\n          <div style={{marginTop: 12, fontSize: 13}}>订单</div>\n          <div style={{marginTop: 8, fontSize: 13, opacity: 0.65}}>客户</div>\n          <div style={{marginTop: 8, fontSize: 13, opacity: 0.65}}>库存</div>\n        </div>\n      )}\n      <div style={{flex: 1, padding: 12, background: '#fafafa'}}>\n        {isMobile && (\n          <Alert\n            style={{marginBottom: 12}}\n            type=\"warning\"\n            showIcon\n            message=\"移动端：侧栏收起，改用顶部「筛选」入口\"\n          />\n        )}\n        {children}\n      </div>\n    </div>\n  );\n};\n\nconst UseIsMobileExample = () => {\n  const viewportIsMobile = useIsMobile();\n  const [source, setSource] = useState('viewport');\n  const [containerWidth, setContainerWidth] = useState(414);\n\n  const board = (\n    <Shell>\n      <OrderBoard />\n    </Shell>\n  );\n\n  return (\n    <Flex vertical gap={16}>\n      <Alert\n        showIcon\n        type=\"info\"\n        message={`阈值：宽度 < ${MOBILE_BREAKPOINT}px → isMobile === true`}\n        description=\"业务里优先用本 Hook，不要自己 matchMedia('(max-width: 768px)')。\"\n      />\n\n      <Card size=\"small\" title=\"数据源\">\n        <Radio.Group\n          optionType=\"button\"\n          value={source}\n          onChange={e => setSource(e.target.value)}\n          options={[\n            {label: '视口（当前浏览器）', value: 'viewport'},\n            {label: '容器模拟宽度', value: 'container'}\n          ]}\n        />\n        <div style={{marginTop: 12}}>\n          <Typography.Text type=\"secondary\">\n            视口判定：{' '}\n            <Tag color={viewportIsMobile ? 'orange' : 'blue'}>{String(viewportIsMobile)}</Tag>\n            （改变浏览器宽度即可验证）\n          </Typography.Text>\n        </div>\n        {source === 'container' && (\n          <Space style={{marginTop: 12}} wrap>\n            <Typography.Text>模拟宽度</Typography.Text>\n            <InputNumber\n              min={320}\n              max={1200}\n              value={containerWidth}\n              onChange={v => setContainerWidth(v || 414)}\n              addonAfter=\"px\"\n            />\n            <Radio.Group\n              value={containerWidth}\n              onChange={e => setContainerWidth(e.target.value)}\n              options={[\n                {label: '375', value: 375},\n                {label: '767', value: 767},\n                {label: '768', value: 768},\n                {label: '1024', value: 1024}\n              ]}\n            />\n          </Space>\n        )}\n      </Card>\n\n      {source === 'container' ? (\n        <div style={{width: Math.min(containerWidth, 640), maxWidth: '100%'}}>\n          <Typography.Text type=\"secondary\" style={{display: 'block', marginBottom: 8}}>\n            ResponsiveProvider mode=\"container\" containerWidth={containerWidth}\n          </Typography.Text>\n          <ResponsiveProvider mode=\"container\" containerWidth={containerWidth}>\n            {board}\n          </ResponsiveProvider>\n        </div>\n      ) : (\n        board\n      )}\n    </Flex>\n  );\n};\n\nrender(<UseIsMobileExample />);\n\n",

},{
    title: "useBreakpoint",
    description: "xs~xxl 命中状态驱动表格列、侧栏宽度与栅格",
    code: "/**\n * useBreakpoint：返回 xs~xxl 是否「达到」该宽度，以及 isMobile\n *\n * 适合比「是否移动端」更细的栅格 / 侧栏 / 表格列显隐\n * 判定语义：width >= BREAKPOINTS[key]\n */\nconst {BREAKPOINTS, ResponsiveProvider, useBreakpoint} = _ResponsiveUtils;\nconst {Alert, Card, Col, Flex, Radio, Row, Space, Table, Tag, Typography} = antd;\nconst {useMemo, useState} = React;\n\nconst BREAKPOINT_META = [\n  {key: 'xs', label: '超小屏', hint: '手机竖屏起步'},\n  {key: 'sm', label: '小屏', hint: '手机横屏 / 小平板'},\n  {key: 'md', label: '中屏', hint: '平板；移动端阈值'},\n  {key: 'lg', label: '大屏', hint: '桌面'},\n  {key: 'xl', label: '超大屏', hint: '宽屏桌面'},\n  {key: 'xxl', label: '巨屏', hint: '超宽 / 4K'}\n];\n\nconst STAFF = [\n  {key: '1', name: '陈晓', dept: '研发中心', city: '上海', role: '前端', phone: '138****1201'},\n  {key: '2', name: '林舟', dept: '产品中心', city: '北京', role: '产品', phone: '139****8830'},\n  {key: '3', name: '周宁', dept: '运营中心', city: '深圳', role: '运营', phone: '137****4412'}\n];\n\nconst StaffTable = () => {\n  const bp = useBreakpoint();\n\n  const columns = useMemo(() => {\n    const cols = [\n      {title: '姓名', dataIndex: 'name'},\n      {title: '部门', dataIndex: 'dept'}\n    ];\n    if (bp.md) cols.push({title: '城市', dataIndex: 'city'});\n    if (bp.lg) cols.push({title: '岗位', dataIndex: 'role'});\n    if (bp.xl) cols.push({title: '手机', dataIndex: 'phone'});\n    return cols;\n  }, [bp.md, bp.lg, bp.xl]);\n\n  const gutter = bp.xxl ? 24 : bp.lg ? 16 : 8;\n  const siderWidth = bp.isMobile ? 0 : bp.xl ? 220 : bp.lg ? 180 : 140;\n\n  return (\n    <Flex vertical gap={12}>\n      <Space wrap>\n        <Tag color={bp.isMobile ? 'orange' : 'blue'}>isMobile={String(bp.isMobile)}</Tag>\n        <Tag>可见列数 {columns.length}</Tag>\n        <Tag>栅格 gutter {gutter}</Tag>\n        {!bp.isMobile && <Tag>侧栏 {siderWidth}px</Tag>}\n      </Space>\n      <div style={{display: 'flex', gap: gutter, border: '1px solid #f0f0f0', borderRadius: 8}}>\n        {!bp.isMobile && (\n          <div\n            style={{\n              width: siderWidth,\n              padding: 12,\n              background: '#001529',\n              color: '#fff',\n              borderRadius: '8px 0 0 8px'\n            }}\n          >\n            组织树\n            <div style={{marginTop: 8, opacity: 0.7, fontSize: 12}}>研发中心</div>\n            <div style={{marginTop: 4, opacity: 0.7, fontSize: 12}}>产品中心</div>\n          </div>\n        )}\n        <div style={{flex: 1, padding: 12}}>\n          <Table size=\"small\" pagination={false} columns={columns} dataSource={STAFF} />\n          <Row gutter={[gutter, gutter]} style={{marginTop: 12}}>\n            {['在职', '试用', '待入职'].map(label => (\n              <Col key={label} span={bp.lg ? 8 : bp.md ? 12 : 24}>\n                <Card size=\"small\">{label}统计卡</Card>\n              </Col>\n            ))}\n          </Row>\n        </div>\n      </div>\n    </Flex>\n  );\n};\n\nconst HitList = () => {\n  const bp = useBreakpoint();\n  return (\n    <Flex vertical gap={8}>\n      {BREAKPOINT_META.map(({key, label, hint}) => (\n        <Flex key={key} justify=\"space-between\" align=\"center\">\n          <Space>\n            <Tag color={bp[key] ? 'processing' : 'default'}>{key}</Tag>\n            <Typography.Text>\n              {label}（≥{BREAKPOINTS[key]}px）\n            </Typography.Text>\n            <Typography.Text type=\"secondary\">{hint}</Typography.Text>\n          </Space>\n          <Tag color={bp[key] ? 'success' : 'default'}>{bp[key] ? '命中' : '未达'}</Tag>\n        </Flex>\n      ))}\n    </Flex>\n  );\n};\n\nconst UseBreakpointExample = () => {\n  const [mode, setMode] = useState('viewport');\n  const [width, setWidth] = useState(1024);\n\n  const content = (\n    <Flex vertical gap={16}>\n      <Card size=\"small\" title=\"断点命中（≥ 阈值）\">\n        <HitList />\n      </Card>\n      <Card size=\"small\" title=\"业务用法：表格列 + 侧栏 + 栅格随断点变化\">\n        <StaffTable />\n      </Card>\n    </Flex>\n  );\n\n  return (\n    <Flex vertical gap={16}>\n      <Alert\n        showIcon\n        type=\"info\"\n        message=\"useBreakpoint 比 useIsMobile 更细\"\n        description=\"只判断移动端用 useIsMobile；需要「lg 才显示手机列」这类逻辑时用本 Hook。\"\n      />\n      <Radio.Group\n        optionType=\"button\"\n        value={mode}\n        onChange={e => setMode(e.target.value)}\n        options={[\n          {label: '跟视口', value: 'viewport'},\n          {label: '模拟宽度', value: 'container'}\n        ]}\n      />\n      {mode === 'container' && (\n        <Radio.Group\n          value={width}\n          onChange={e => setWidth(e.target.value)}\n          options={[\n            {label: '375 xs', value: 375},\n            {label: '600 sm', value: 600},\n            {label: '800 md', value: 800},\n            {label: '1100 lg', value: 1100},\n            {label: '1300 xl', value: 1300},\n            {label: '1700 xxl', value: 1700}\n          ]}\n        />\n      )}\n      {mode === 'container' ? (\n        <ResponsiveProvider mode=\"container\" containerWidth={width}>\n          {content}\n        </ResponsiveProvider>\n      ) : (\n        content\n      )}\n    </Flex>\n  );\n};\n\nrender(<UseBreakpointExample />);\n\n",

    title: "useMediaQuery",
    description: "订阅任意 media query；container 下 max-width 映射到 getIsMobile",
    code: "/**\n * useMediaQuery：订阅任意 CSS media query\n *\n * - 视口模式：标准 matchMedia\n * - container 模式：含 max-width 的 query 会映射到 Provider.getIsMobile()\n */\nconst {ResponsiveProvider, IS_MOBILE_QUERY, useIsMobile, useMediaQuery} = _ResponsiveUtils;\nconst {Alert, Card, Flex, InputNumber, Space, Switch, Tag, Typography} = antd;\nconst {useState} = React;\n\nconst QUERIES = [\n  {label: '官方移动端 query', query: IS_MOBILE_QUERY, note: '与 useIsMobile 同源'},\n  {label: '紧凑布局', query: '(max-width: 576px)', note: '可驱动更窄的表单间距'},\n  {label: '宽屏工作台', query: '(min-width: 1200px)', note: 'container 下 min-width 仍走真实视口'},\n  {label: '横屏', query: '(orientation: landscape)', note: '设备方向'},\n  {label: '深色偏好', query: '(prefers-color-scheme: dark)', note: '系统主题'}\n];\n\nconst QueryRow = ({label, query, note}) => {\n  const matches = useMediaQuery(query);\n  return (\n    <Flex justify=\"space-between\" align=\"center\" gap={12}>\n      <div>\n        <Typography.Text>{label}</Typography.Text>\n        <br />\n        <Typography.Text type=\"secondary\" style={{fontSize: 12}} code>\n          {query}\n        </Typography.Text>\n        {note && (\n          <>\n            <br />\n            <Typography.Text type=\"secondary\" style={{fontSize: 12}}>\n              {note}\n            </Typography.Text>\n          </>\n        )}\n      </div>\n      <Tag color={matches ? 'success' : 'default'}>{matches ? '匹配' : '不匹配'}</Tag>\n    </Flex>\n  );\n};\n\nconst Panel = () => {\n  const isMobile = useIsMobile();\n  return (\n    <Flex vertical gap={12}>\n      <Space>\n        <Typography.Text>useIsMobile</Typography.Text>\n        <Tag color={isMobile ? 'orange' : 'blue'}>{String(isMobile)}</Tag>\n      </Space>\n      {QUERIES.map(item => (\n        <Card key={item.query} size=\"small\">\n          <QueryRow {...item} />\n        </Card>\n      ))}\n    </Flex>\n  );\n};\n\nconst UseMediaQueryExample = () => {\n  const [containerMode, setContainerMode] = useState(false);\n  const [containerWidth, setContainerWidth] = useState(500);\n\n  return (\n    <Flex vertical gap={16}>\n      <Alert\n        showIcon\n        type=\"info\"\n        message=\"何时用 useMediaQuery？\"\n        description=\"只要「是不是移动端」→ useIsMobile；任意 query / 方向 / 配色偏好 → 用本 Hook。\"\n      />\n\n      <Card size=\"small\" title=\"运行环境\">\n        <Space wrap>\n          <Typography.Text>容器模式</Typography.Text>\n          <Switch checked={containerMode} onChange={setContainerMode} />\n          {containerMode && (\n            <>\n              <Typography.Text>containerWidth</Typography.Text>\n              <InputNumber\n                min={320}\n                max={1600}\n                value={containerWidth}\n                onChange={v => setContainerWidth(v || 500)}\n                addonAfter=\"px\"\n              />\n            </>\n          )}\n        </Space>\n        <Typography.Paragraph type=\"secondary\" style={{marginTop: 12, marginBottom: 0}}>\n          打开容器模式后，调节宽度观察含 <Typography.Text code>max-width</Typography.Text>{' '}\n          的条目；其它 query（横屏、深色、min-width）仍跟随真实浏览器。\n        </Typography.Paragraph>\n      </Card>\n\n      {containerMode ? (\n        <ResponsiveProvider mode=\"container\" containerWidth={containerWidth}>\n          <Card size=\"small\" title={`容器 ${containerWidth}px`}>\n            <Panel />\n          </Card>\n        </ResponsiveProvider>\n      ) : (\n        <Card size=\"small\" title=\"视口模式\">\n          <Panel />\n        </Card>\n      )}\n    </Flex>\n  );\n};\n\nrender(<UseMediaQueryExample />);\n\n",

    title: "usePopupContainer",
    description: "对比 overflow:hidden 下未挂载 / 已挂载 antd 浮层",
    code: "/**\n * usePopupContainer：给 antd 浮层一个不会被 overflow 裁剪的挂载点\n *\n * 对比：左侧未传 getPopupContainer（易被裁剪），右侧使用 Hook\n */\nconst {\n  ResponsiveProvider,\n  RESPONSIVE_BOUNDARY_CLASS,\n  usePopupContainer,\n  useIsMobile\n} = _ResponsiveUtils;\nconst {Alert, Card, Col, DatePicker, Flex, Row, Select, Tooltip, Typography} = antd;\nconst {useRef} = React;\n\nconst DEPARTMENT_OPTIONS = [\n  {label: '研发中心 / 前端组', value: 'fe'},\n  {label: '研发中心 / 后端组', value: 'be'},\n  {label: '产品中心 / 设计组', value: 'design'},\n  {label: '运营中心 / 增长组', value: 'growth'}\n];\n\nconst BrokenForm = () => (\n  <Flex vertical gap={12}>\n    <Typography.Text type=\"danger\">未传 getPopupContainer —— 打开下拉看裁剪</Typography.Text>\n    <Select style={{width: '100%'}} placeholder=\"选择部门\" options={DEPARTMENT_OPTIONS} />\n    <DatePicker style={{width: '100%'}} placeholder=\"合同日期\" />\n    <Tooltip title=\"这段提示在 overflow:hidden 下可能被裁掉\">\n      <Typography.Link>悬停 Tooltip</Typography.Link>\n    </Tooltip>\n  </Flex>\n);\n\nconst FixedForm = () => {\n  const getPopupContainer = usePopupContainer();\n  const isMobile = useIsMobile();\n  return (\n    <Flex vertical gap={12}>\n      <Typography.Text type=\"success\">\n        usePopupContainer() · 当前 {isMobile ? '移动端' : '桌面端'}\n      </Typography.Text>\n      <Select\n        style={{width: '100%'}}\n        placeholder=\"选择部门\"\n        options={DEPARTMENT_OPTIONS}\n        getPopupContainer={getPopupContainer}\n      />\n      <DatePicker.RangePicker\n        style={{width: '100%'}}\n        getPopupContainer={getPopupContainer}\n        placeholder={['开始', '结束']}\n      />\n      <Tooltip title=\"挂到 boundary 后完整可见\" getPopupContainer={getPopupContainer}>\n        <Typography.Link>悬停 Tooltip</Typography.Link>\n      </Tooltip>\n    </Flex>\n  );\n};\n\nconst UsePopupContainerExample = () => {\n  const boundaryRef = useRef(null);\n\n  return (\n    <Flex vertical gap={16}>\n      <Alert\n        showIcon\n        type=\"info\"\n        message=\"用法一句话\"\n        description={\n          <span>\n            <Typography.Text code>const getPopupContainer = usePopupContainer();</Typography.Text>\n            {' → '}\n            传给 Select / DatePicker / Tooltip / Dropdown 的同名 prop。\n          </span>\n        }\n      />\n\n      <Row gutter={16}>\n        <Col xs={24} md={12} style={{marginBottom: 16}}>\n          <div\n            style={{\n              position: 'relative',\n              overflow: 'hidden',\n              height: 220,\n              border: '2px solid #ffa39e',\n              borderRadius: 8,\n              padding: 16,\n              background: '#fff2f0'\n            }}\n          >\n            <Card size=\"small\" title=\"反例：会被裁剪\">\n              <BrokenForm />\n            </Card>\n          </div>\n        </Col>\n        <Col xs={24} md={12} style={{marginBottom: 16}}>\n          <div\n            ref={boundaryRef}\n            className={RESPONSIVE_BOUNDARY_CLASS}\n            style={{\n              position: 'relative',\n              overflow: 'hidden',\n              height: 220,\n              border: '2px solid #95de64',\n              borderRadius: 8,\n              padding: 16,\n              background: '#f6ffed'\n            }}\n          >\n            <ResponsiveProvider boundaryRef={boundaryRef}>\n              <Card size=\"small\" title=\"正例：挂到 boundary\">\n                <FixedForm />\n              </Card>\n            </ResponsiveProvider>\n          </div>\n        </Col>\n      </Row>\n\n      <Card size=\"small\">\n        <Typography.Paragraph type=\"secondary\" style={{marginBottom: 0}}>\n          页面根节点打上 <Typography.Text code>{RESPONSIVE_BOUNDARY_CLASS}</Typography.Text>{' '}\n          后，多数情况不必再传 <Typography.Text code>boundaryRef</Typography.Text>\n          。移动端全屏 Modal / 半屏请改用 <Typography.Text code>useMobilePopupMount</Typography.Text>。\n        </Typography.Paragraph>\n      </Card>\n    </Flex>\n  );\n};\n\nrender(<UsePopupContainerExample />);\n\n",

    title: "useScrollElement",
    description: "主内容区滚动监控、回顶与锚点跳转",
    code: "/**\n * useScrollElement：拿到真正的滚动根\n *\n * 后台常在「主内容区」滚，而不是 window。锚点、Affix、锁滚动、虚拟列表都需要这个 getter。\n */\nconst {\n  ResponsiveProvider,\n  RESPONSIVE_SCROLL_CLASS,\n  useScrollElement\n} = _ResponsiveUtils;\nconst {Alert, Button, Card, Flex, Space, Typography} = antd;\nconst {useEffect, useRef, useState} = React;\n\nconst APPROVALS = Array.from({length: 12}, (_, i) => ({\n  id: 10086 + i,\n  title: `差旅报销单 #${10086 + i}`,\n  owner: ['陈晓', '林舟', '周宁'][i % 3],\n  status: ['待部门经理', '待财务', '已通过'][i % 3]\n}));\n\nconst ScrollToolbar = () => {\n  const getScrollElement = useScrollElement();\n  const [info, setInfo] = useState({scrollTop: 0, clientHeight: 0, scrollHeight: 0, tag: '-'});\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    const el = getScrollElement();\n    if (!el) return undefined;\n    const update = () => {\n      setInfo({\n        scrollTop: Math.round(el.scrollTop || 0),\n        clientHeight: el.clientHeight || 0,\n        scrollHeight: el.scrollHeight || 0,\n        tag: el.className || el.tagName\n      });\n    };\n    update();\n    el.addEventListener('scroll', update, {passive: true});\n    return () => el.removeEventListener('scroll', update);\n  }, [getScrollElement]);\n\n  return (\n    <Card size=\"small\" title=\"滚动监控（业务组件内）\" style={{position: 'sticky', top: 0, zIndex: 1}}>\n      <Typography.Paragraph style={{marginBottom: 8}}>\n        当前滚动根：<Typography.Text code>{info.tag}</Typography.Text>\n      </Typography.Paragraph>\n      <Typography.Text type=\"secondary\">\n        scrollTop {info.scrollTop} / 可视 {info.clientHeight} / 总高 {info.scrollHeight}\n      </Typography.Text>\n      <div style={{marginTop: 8}}>\n        <Space>\n          <Button\n            size=\"small\"\n            onClick={() => getScrollElement()?.scrollTo({top: 0, behavior: 'smooth'})}\n          >\n            回顶\n          </Button>\n          <Button\n            size=\"small\"\n            onClick={() => {\n              const el = getScrollElement();\n              el?.scrollTo({top: el.scrollHeight, behavior: 'smooth'});\n            }}\n          >\n            到底\n          </Button>\n          <Button\n            size=\"small\"\n            onClick={() => {\n              const el = getScrollElement();\n              const target = el?.querySelector('[data-anchor=\"finance\"]');\n              target?.scrollIntoView({behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start'});\n            }}\n          >\n            跳到「待财务」区块\n          </Button>\n        </Space>\n      </div>\n    </Card>\n  );\n};\n\nconst UseScrollElementExample = () => {\n  const scrollRef = useRef(null);\n\n  return (\n    <Flex vertical gap={16}>\n      <Alert\n        showIcon\n        type=\"info\"\n        message=\"用法\"\n        description={\n          <span>\n            <Typography.Text code>const getScrollElement = useScrollElement();</Typography.Text>\n            {' → '}\n            <Typography.Text code>getScrollElement()</Typography.Text> 得到 HTMLElement，再监听 scroll /\n            scrollTo / 量尺寸。\n          </span>\n        }\n      />\n\n      <div\n        ref={scrollRef}\n        className={RESPONSIVE_SCROLL_CLASS}\n        style={{\n          height: 280,\n          overflow: 'auto',\n          border: '1px solid #d9d9d9',\n          borderRadius: 8,\n          padding: 12,\n          background: '#fafafa'\n        }}\n      >\n        <ResponsiveProvider scrollRef={scrollRef}>\n          <ScrollToolbar />\n          <Flex vertical gap={8} style={{marginTop: 12}}>\n            {APPROVALS.map(item => (\n              <Card\n                key={item.id}\n                size=\"small\"\n                data-anchor={item.status === '待财务' ? 'finance' : undefined}\n              >\n                <Typography.Text strong>{item.title}</Typography.Text>\n                <br />\n                <Typography.Text type=\"secondary\">\n                  {item.owner} · {item.status}\n                </Typography.Text>\n              </Card>\n            ))}\n          </Flex>\n        </ResponsiveProvider>\n      </div>\n\n      <Typography.Paragraph type=\"secondary\" style={{marginBottom: 0}}>\n        也可只标 <Typography.Text code>{RESPONSIVE_SCROLL_CLASS}</Typography.Text>\n        ，不传 scrollRef。打开弹层锁滚动等场景常与 <Typography.Text code>usePopupContainer</Typography.Text>{' '}\n        一起用。\n      </Typography.Paragraph>\n    </Flex>\n  );\n};\n\nrender(<UseScrollElementExample />);\n\n",
    scope: [{

    title: "useMobilePopupMount",
    description: "cover=boundary / viewport：对照 container 与 viewport 两种 Provider 模式下的挂载结果",
    code: "/**\n * useMobilePopupMount：移动端弹层一站式挂载\n *\n * 业务只选 cover：\n * - cover='boundary'（默认）：罩住 Provider boundary —— Modal 推荐\n * - cover='viewport'：罩住当前移动可视区 —— 半屏 Select / Sheet\n *     · mode=container → 挂 boundary + kne-is-boundary\n *     · mode=viewport 且移动端 → body + kne-is-viewport\n */\nconst {\n  ResponsiveProvider,\n  RESPONSIVE_BOUNDARY_CLASS,\n  RESPONSIVE_SCROLL_CLASS,\n  MOBILE_POPUP_MODE,\n  MOBILE_POPUP_COVER,\n  useMobilePopupMount,\n  useResponsiveContext\n} = _ResponsiveUtils;\nconst {Alert, Button, Card, Descriptions, Flex, Radio, Space, Tag, Typography} = antd;\nconst {useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState} = React;\nconst {createPortal} = ReactDOM;\n\nconst PHONE_WIDTH = 375;\nconst PHONE_HEIGHT = 620;\n\nconst formatMount = node => {\n  if (!node) return '-';\n  if (node === document.body) return 'document.body';\n  const cls = node.className || '';\n  if (cls.includes(RESPONSIVE_BOUNDARY_CLASS)) return `.${RESPONSIVE_BOUNDARY_CLASS}`;\n  return cls || node.tagName;\n};\n\n/** 演示弹层：按 fixedModeClass 切换 absolute / fixed */\nconst DemoOverlay = ({open, fixedModeClass, title, onClose, mountNode}) => {\n  if (!open || !mountNode) return null;\n  const useAbsolute = fixedModeClass === MOBILE_POPUP_MODE.boundary;\n  const position = useAbsolute ? 'absolute' : 'fixed';\n\n  return createPortal(\n    <>\n      <div\n        className={fixedModeClass || undefined}\n        style={{position, inset: 0, background: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.45)', zIndex: 1000}}\n        onClick={onClose}\n      />\n      <div\n        className={fixedModeClass || undefined}\n        style={{\n          position,\n          left: 0,\n          right: 0,\n          bottom: 0,\n          zIndex: 1001,\n          background: '#fff',\n          borderRadius: '12px 12px 0 0',\n          padding: 16,\n          boxShadow: '0 -6px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.12)',\n          maxHeight: '70%',\n          overflow: 'auto'\n        }}\n      >\n        <Flex justify=\"space-between\" align=\"center\" style={{marginBottom: 12}}>\n          <Typography.Text strong>{title}</Typography.Text>\n          <Button type=\"link\" onClick={onClose}>\n            关闭\n          </Button>\n        </Flex>\n        <Typography.Paragraph type=\"secondary\" style={{marginBottom: 8}}>\n          fixedModeClass = <Typography.Text code>{fixedModeClass || 'null（桌面）'}</Typography.Text>\n        </Typography.Paragraph>\n        <Typography.Paragraph type=\"secondary\" style={{marginBottom: 0}}>\n          mount = <Typography.Text code>{formatMount(mountNode)}</Typography.Text>\n        </Typography.Paragraph>\n        <div style={{height: 100, marginTop: 12, background: '#f5f5f5', borderRadius: 8, padding: 12}}>\n          组件侧 CSS：.kne-is-boundary 用 absolute；.kne-is-viewport 用 fixed。\n        </div>\n      </div>\n    </>,\n    mountNode\n  );\n};\n\nconst MountDemo = ({cover, title, tip}) => {\n  const {mode} = useResponsiveContext();\n  const {isMobile, fixedModeClass, getMountNode, getPopupContainer, anchorRef} = useMobilePopupMount({\n    cover\n  });\n  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);\n  const [mountNode, setMountNode] = useState(null);\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    if (!open) {\n      setMountNode(null);\n      return;\n    }\n    const trigger = document.querySelector(`[data-cover=\"${cover}\"][data-mode=\"${mode}\"]`);\n    setMountNode(getMountNode(trigger) || getPopupContainer(trigger));\n  }, [open, cover, mode, getMountNode, getPopupContainer]);\n\n  return (\n    <Card\n      size=\"small\"\n      title={title}\n      extra={<Tag color={cover === 'viewport' ? 'document.body' : el.className || el.tagName;\n      })(),\n      resolveScrollElement: (() => {\n        const el = resolveScrollElement(scrollRef, anchor);\n        return el.className ||
